Edward Liu, Director of Applied Deep Learning Research: DLSS 5 adds a THIRD category of AI to real-time rendering - generation - alongside reconstruction (the current DLSS suite) and function approximation (Neural Radiance Cache, Neural Materials). The renderer still builds the world and geometry is untouched; a generative model enriches appearance, conditioned on the rendered frame plus renderer internal buffers (albedos, surface normals, lighting) and motion vectors, so it runs causally, one frame in one frame out, with no shimmer or drifting. The model is distilled from giant foundation models into a much smaller one-step pixel space diffusion transformer to fit the real-time budget: a 4K frame is about 8 million pixels and at larger than 60 FPS the whole budget is less than 16 milliseconds, most of which the game itself consumes.
